hook: *₹2.12 lakh crore* defence buy approved. *82%* goes to Indian makers
tldr: The Defence Acquisition Council approved deals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore for the Army, Navy and Air Force: kamikaze and surveillance drones, counter-drone systems, very short-range air defence, decoys against anti-ship missiles, helicopters and weather radars. About 82% is earmarked for domestic industry.

beats.what: Approvals (AoN) cover drones, C-UAS, VSHORADS, self-propelled guns, heavy vehicles, naval decoys and IAF helicopters and radars.
beats.why: Drone and missile threats are the new battlefield; the forces want more indigenous kit.
beats.care: Big orders for Indian defence firms, many with plants and suppliers around Hyderabad's defence cluster.

cards.q: What share of the ₹2.12 lakh crore goes to Indian industry?
cards.why: About 82% of the procurement value is earmarked for domestic industry.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Centre approves defence deals worth ₹2.12 lakh cr. (print, Hyderabad edition, 27 Oct, p.8)
